profile.headline: Full-Stack Web Developer | PHP · JavaScript · React (in progress) · WordPress & MODX
profile.summary:
Driven Web Developer with 10+ years of hands-on experience crafting responsive, user-centric interfaces. I turn business requirements into pixel-perfect HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript UIs—leveraging Bootstrap and Tailwind to ship faster without sacrificing quality.

While my core strength lies in front-end development, I’m equally comfortable under the hood:

• APIs & Integrations: Seamlessly consume RESTful services (SMTP, ERP imports, third-party tools)
• Backend Foundations: PHP, WordPress & MySQL expertise that lets me collaborate across the full stack
• Performance & Accessibility: Audit and optimize sites for speed, WCAG compliance, and maintainability

I’m methodical, detail-obsessed, and relentless about staying current with web standards and best practices. Right now I’m expanding into Node.js/Express microservices, containerized deployments, and advanced API design—on track to step into a Senior Full-Stack Developer role.

Let’s connect if you need someone who can own end-to-end features, mentor teammates, and drive projects from concept to launch.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to transform design concepts into ADA-compliant, cross-browser-compatible e-commerce sites—ensuring every visual element aligned with brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
• Architected custom solutions to overcome limited platform functionality and established a streamlined Git workflow for the “Foundation” project, boosting team collaboration and delivery efficiency.
• Led client engagements to gather requirements, managed and triaged bug tickets, and drove timely issue resolution—resulting in successful, on-schedule implementation of tailored e-commerce solutions.
positions.insights: Front-End Development, W3C Accessibility and +1 skill

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and tested prototype WordPress forms with seamless integrations into Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho—streamlining lead capture and CRM workflows.
• Crafted visually appealing, user-centric layouts that adhere to best-practice interaction standards, then maintained and updated client sites on WP Engine with proactive support and clear communication.
• Analyzed Hotjar recordings and Google Analytics data to optimize landing pages for conversion—iteratively improving form performance and driving measurable client results.
positions.insights: Front-End Development, Client Relations and +2 skills

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer
positions.description: Experienced WordPress developer specializing in creating custom, mobile-friendly WordPress sites that meet clients' needs and industry standards. Skilled in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and PHP to build and maintain sites and develop custom landing pages to increase conversion rates. Expertly manages email marketing campaigns, ensuring effective targeting and message delivery, while analyzing campaign performance to inform future efforts. Provides efficient resolution of site and server issues for clients to minimize downtime and optimize site performance. Works closely with account leads to establish client expectations and deadlines, providing guidance on technical requirements and limitations to ensure successful project delivery.
